rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an expression of praise or approval.

example.english: I received a lot of compliment, and it really made me happy.
example.traditional: 我收到好多稱讚，真係幾開心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sau1 dou2 hou2 do1 cing1 zaan3 zan1 hai6 gei2 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when the compliment sounds flattering or ingratiating rather than straightforward praise.

example.english: Their compliment to the client was clearly meant to get something in return.
example.traditional: 佢成日恭維個客，好明顯係想攞着數。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gung1 wai4 go3 haak3 hou2 ming4 hin2 hai6 soeng2 lo2 zoek6 sou3
